comment.body: 现有诊断中的 untrusted-signature 线索已经由 #51567 跟踪，#51789 是相应的候选修复，但目前仍未合并或发布。新回复描述的启动钩子和内存补丁仅是该参与者的本机测试说明，不能视为 PowerToys 支持的修复方式；请不要为了配对而注入 DLL、放宽对端校验或混用不同版本的程序。无需重复提交原有材料。后续应在一致的、正常签名的产品构建上验证候选修复，且不要公开配对密钥。

judgment.recommended_action: Acknowledge the new diagnostic explanation and direct validation to the existing signed-product candidate, not process hooks or mixed binaries.
evidence: The original0.102.3001 report supplies an image and a diagnostic archive for failure while generating a key. The earlier inspection of that supplied archive established SettingsSync untrusted-signature rejection in Settings/MWB logs.
The new November4 participant describes a local startup-hook/Harmony certificate-comparison patch and claims local tests, but supplies no independently verified supported product build.
Existing51567 and open/unmerged51789 cover the demonstrated signer-rejection class. The proposed PR is still under review.
judgment.rationale: The new reply does not resolve the upstream issue and should not become an endorsed workaround. Keep the existing diagnosis and ownership; do not execute or distribute the community hook, recommend disabling peer checks, or request the same evidence again.

fix_assessment.rationale: Existing51567 investigation/open51789 candidate covers the observed rejection. The community memory-patch claim is neither a supported fix nor proof that51789 is ready.

issue_context.summary: Existing diagnostics support a signer-rejection investigation; the new community in-memory patch claim is not a supported product repair.
issue_context.analysis: The new reply does not resolve the upstream issue and should not become an endorsed workaround. Keep the existing diagnosis and ownership; do not execute or distribute the community hook, recommend disabling peer checks, or request the same evidence again.
initial_investigation: Read the full original report, all current replies and timeline; retained the prior supplied-archive inspection rather than redownloading unchanged evidence.
Read the new hook description only as untrusted diagnostic discussion; no attached code was executed, no local peer-verification policy was changed.
Verified51789 remains open/unmerged and has new review feedback.
inferences: A claimed successful local hook can support a hypothesis, but cannot certify its safety, other installations, service mode or the upstream candidate.
